div.head: Had 5
div.ab: 7 to hadbote, gif fullbryce wurðe, toeacan þam rihtwere, æt þam feorðan stæpe IIII pund.
Et ad emendationem ordinis, si plena infractio fiat, supra rectam weram in quarto gradu quatuor libre reddantur cum penitentia.
And to hadbote, gif fulbryce wyrðe, toeacan þam rihtwere, æt þam feorðan stæpe feower pund to bote, mid godcundan scrifte.
And to hadbote, gif fullbryce wurðe, toeacan þam rihtwere æt þam feorðan stæpe iiii pund to bote, mid godcundan scrifte.
Und wenn tödtliche Verletzung eintritt: ausser dem gesetzlichen Wergeld, beim vierten Ordo als Klerusbusse 4 Pfund zur Busse, neben geistlicher Poenitenz.
And if fatal injury occurs: besides the lawful wergild, for the fourth grade 4 pounds as compensation for orders, with spiritual penance.

And as compensation for one in orders if a full breach of the peace occurs, the perpetrator must make amends for the fourth rank by paying four pounds as a penalty in addition to the standard wergild and by doing spiritual penance.

And in compensation for [an offence against a man in] orders, if a full breach occurs, one must pay for the fourth degree with four pounds in addition to the legal wergild, and intercede zealously with ecclesiastical penance.
div.note: H ends at ‘IIII pund’; Liebermann supplies the rest (‘to bote, mid godcundan scrifte’) from the others.; U: not in Whitelock’s English Historical Documents, which prints only Had 1–2 and 9–11 (with “…” for the rest); the source of this translation is not recorded.
pund to: to . . . scrifte: omitted H, text supplied from D
and by doing spiritual penance: The end of this clause is omitted from Textus Roffensis, likely inadvertently, but present in Cambridge, Corpus Christi College MSS 190 and 201.
